targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: -30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gauge" or r._measurement == "aem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_measurement","node","_field","_value"])
  |> group() |> sort(columns: ["_measurement","node","_field"])

from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gauge")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "soc_pct")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["node"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gauge")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "voltage_mv")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 1000.0 }))
  |> group(columns: ["node"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
